line_item: DIFFERENT POPULATIONS, same period, same note -- not a genuine inconsistency and not double-counted. Table 2 ($56bn, heading 'Additional Commitments') is NVIDIA's firm/executory commitments to support AI-cloud partners (AI cloud service agreements NVIDIA has committed to buy back capacity on/lease payments, plus data-center leases NVIDIA holds and 'expect[s] to reassign...to third parties'). Table 3 ($108.5bn, heading 'Guarantees') is a DIFFERENT obligation type: maximum CONTINGENT exposure if a customer defaults -- 'Land, power, and shell guarantees for AI clouds' ($3.5bn, pre-existing) plus the new August-2026 'SB Energy Corp. guarantees' ($105.0bn, capped, for the OpenAI/PORTS Technology Campus buildout, effective only as each of nine lease phases commences from FY2029). Table 1 ($366bn) is a THIRD, still different population: NVIDIA's own supply-chain/manufacturing/R&D commitments to ITS OWN suppliers, unrelated to customer guarantees. All three tables share the same 'as of July 26, 2026' date -- this is not a timing artifact.
